connector.name: Supernote
connector.registryDescription: Capture the screen, read/render notes, and upload files on a Ratta Supernote from an AI agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package supernote-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ridget account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SUPERNOTE_IP
env.description: Device IP (optionally with :port) from the Supernote mirroring popup. Optional — if unset, the server scans the LAN for the mirror.

env.name: SUPERNOTE_DISCOVER
env.description: Set to 0 to disable the LAN-scan fallback used when SUPERNOTE_IP is unset or unreachable.
